items.item_text: Board certified/eligible in Internal Medicine or Family Medicine, required.
Board certified/eligible in Geriatric Medicine, preferred.

UCLA Health is an integrated health system with a certified patient-centered medical home model where your skills, expertise and passion define our outstanding care. Discover all UCan achieve in your practice at UCLA Health.

UCLA Health is seeking a dedicated Senior Care Physician to join our innovative Senior Care Model clinic in Encino. This role is designed to deliver high-value, patient-centered primary care for adults aged 65 and older. Built on the Age-Friendly Health System’s “5Ms” framework—What Matters, Medication, Mentation, Mobility, and Multi-Complexity—this clinic will provide longitudinal primary and acute care services tailored to the needs of the aging population.
Learn more about the expansion of our
Provide comprehensive primary care for a smaller patient panel to enhance patient access and personalized care.
Enjoy sharing quality visit times with your patients with longer visits
Work in a collaborative, interdisciplinary team including Clinical Advisor RNs, Comprehensive Care Coordinators, and Licensed Clinical Social Workers to support patient care.
Dedicate 32 hours per week to direct patient care, with additional time allocated for administration and chronic care management.
Develop professionally through specialized education focused on chronic care management, value-based care, and population health strategies.
Collaborate with the Senior Care Model Medical Director to drive quality improvement initiatives and evaluate new care delivery models.
Passion for delivering patient-centered geriatric care and improving health outcomes for older adults.
Ideal candidates will be comfortable with telehealth appointments, as needed.
About UCLA Health Senior Care Model:

The Senior Care Model at UCLA Health is an innovative primary care initiative designed to enhance healthcare delivery for older adults. It integrates evidence-based geriatric care, population health strategies, and advanced coordination services to ensure seniors receive the highest-quality care tailored to their needs.
